versions.changelog:
Initial release of Binance quantitative trading monitoring system.

- Real-time monitoring of Binance trading pairs' price and volume
- Analyzes strategy performance (win rate, P/L ratio, max drawdown)
- Generates hourly and daily trading reports
- Supports risk alerts via Feishu, email, SMS, etc.
- Configurable trading strategies and parameters
- Includes setup instructions and sample configuration
